name: office-scribe
description: Local conversation scribe and cited recall through Orbit Office.

workspace.title: Local Office workspace
workspace.description: Absolute local registered Orbit checkout on this Mac. An absolute path is an Orbit workspace selector; remote selectors are refused.

default_on.title: Live scribe on for new sessions
default_on.description: SessionEnd still captures when live passes are off. Excluded projects are always skipped.

excluded_projects.title: Excluded project paths
excluded_projects.description: JSON array of absolute paths. These paths and their physical descendants are never staged or captured, including by backfill.
